closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, carb quality, and calcium, but the biggest weaknesses are saturated fat, low vitamin A, and dense and easy to overshoot. It is good for bone health, immune support, and blood and oxygen support because calcium and magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, vitamin A and zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, and vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side.
